game.name: Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition

items.text: This update introduces a number of changes on PC, including gameplay fixes, Toolset fixes and networking fixes.
Please continue to report any bugs to our support team at support.aspyr.com.
Fixed a crash when placing any tile in an interior area.
Fixed a crash when using the StoreCampaignObject() function.
Fixed black terrain issues.
Fixed an issue with missing tileset mesh and texture options.
Fixed an issue where metatiles break when rotated.
Fixed a crash after exiting the Starling House while in Exploration Mode.
Fixed a crash when switching tabs in the Give Item section in the Cheats menu.
Fixed an issue where the camera is positioned outside of the map after transitioning between areas as a companion while in Exploration Mode.
Fixed an issue where all floating combat text displayed in white.
Fixed an issue with certain text are missing colors in the Character Creation and Character Level Up screens.
Fixed an issue where the game unpauses when using Alt+Tab.
Fixed an issue where dialogue options couldn't be selected with a keyboard.
Fixed an issue preventing pausing during cutscenes.
Fixed an issue where some scroll bars in Character Creation and Level Up screens do not function with the mouse.
This update introduces a number of changes, including gameplay fixes, Toolset fixes and networking fixes. Please continue to report any bugs to our support team at support.aspyr.com.
Fixed a crash related to the Static Camera.
Fixed a crash on the Basic tab in the Properties Panel after selecting "Reset from Package" when certain classes are used for multi-classing.
Fixed a crash related to deleting stock VFX.
Fixed a crash when copying a trigger.
Fixed an issue with the Surface Mesh displaying behind objects after baking.
Fixed an issue with the Script Editor not referencing functions from include files.
Fixed an issue with water displaying incorrectly when using the water brush on terrain.
Fixed an issue with Editor functions not appearing and sorting.
Fixed an issue with the Area Window flashing.
Fixed an issue with area music and ambient sounds not playing.
Fixed an issue with displaying textures in the toolset.
Fixed an issue with deleting text in Script Editor when searching.
Fixed an issue with mouseY invert.
Fixed an issue with grass paint shapes.
Fixed an issue with the FloatToString function.
Fixed an issue with lights not maintaining their tags after saving and reloading.
Fixed an issue with certain dialogue not appearing during cinematics.
Fixed a texture issue with several VFX.
Fixed an issue with the file integrity check running twice when joining PWs.
Added support to the Character Creation screen on custom modules to use the Enhanced Edition UI.
Fixed an issue with Construct in Crossroad Keep Interior.
Fixed an issue with the Behavior section not displaying a mouse hover effect.
Fixed an issue with the party leader switching when talking to One of Many on the Overland Map (SOZ).
Fixed an issue with the Biography text box in the Character Creation menu.
Fixed an issue with the Load Game popup and using the Delete function.
Fixed an issue with chest and lever animations.
Fixed an issue with cyclical navigation on some menus.
Fixed an issue with adding cohorts to a party (SOZ).
Fixed an issue with FPS drops on the character select screen in certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue with using the controller bumpers in certain menus.
Fixed an issue with the default save game names in certain locations.
Fixed an issue with the reset to defaults behavior in Game Options.
Fixed an issue with scaling the chat box.
Fixed an issue with server lag when speaking to certain NPC merchants.
Fixed an issue with chat content disappearing when transitioning between areas.
Fixed an issue with sending private messages.
Fixed an issue with clients not being able to interact with Area Transitions during encounters from the Overland map (SOZ).
Fixed an issue with the default facial hair option with Dwarves.
Fixed an issue with closing the Event Log.
Fixed an issue with the Spirit Energy UI appearing slowly after dialogue.
Fixed an issue with Target Portrait displays.
Fixed an issue with long text inputs in chat.
Fixed an issue with the Area Map in Brother Edens' Shrine.
Fixed some camera issues when walking into certain structures.
Fixed an issue with controller vibrations not triggering when detecting some traps.
Fixed an issue with entering gold numbers into the Barter Board.
Fixed an issue with slow UI transition with the Spirit Energy screen.
Fixed a collision issue with certain crates in Smuggler's Warehouse.
Fixed a graphical issue in the Inner Sanctum.
Fixed a graphical issue when zooming in Imaskari Forges.
Fixed a graphical issue when using the Silver Sword of Gith's "Shard Hail" skill.
Fixed a graphical issue with the City Watch Post after it's set on fire.
Fixed a progression blocker where the player sometimes cannot enter Neverwinter City (SOZ).
We’ve released an update for Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition. Please continue to report any bugs to our support team at support.aspyr.com.
Updated the Toolset to a 64-bit architecture
Fixed an error related to scrolling in the Module Properties
Fixed an error when selecting placeable sounds
Fixed a crash in the Statistics window
Fixed a crash when resizing interior type areas
Fixed an issue to display custom content party chat
Fixed an issue with the Walkermesh helper
Fixed a crash when transitioning to subsequent modules
Fixed an issue with the Preview camera angle
Fixed an issue with Preview in the Armor Set tab
Fixed a visual issue with the Wireframe function when Sky is enabled
Fixed an issue with the Undo function
Fixed an issue with icons not displaying
Fixed an issue with the Appearance Wizard sometimes not loading
Added starting gear in the chest for the Swashbuckler, Favored Soul and Spirit Shaman classes at the beginning of Act I of the Official Campaign
Added Drive Mode Left and Drive Mode Right to the Keymapping screen
Fixed an issue to display a scroll bar in the campaign list in the Select Campaign menu
Fixed an issue with artifacts on some VFX and videos
Fixed issues with the Back button on several screens
Fixed an issue with save game names in Storm of Zehir
Fixed an issue with the Character Sheet not displaying on the Overland map
Fixed a crash in the Give Item cheat menu
Fixed a crash in the Pause Menu when in large areas on Persistent World servers
Fixed an issue with the Event Log when using the Tell option
Fixed an issue with client stability when host saves the game
Fixed an issue with disappearing items when purchased with full inventory
Fixed an issue with the Auto Download speeds when joining a Persistent World server
Fixed an issue with the Faceless Man not triggering dialogue after being defeated (Mask of the Betrayer)
Fixed an issue with the ritual in the Catacombs (Mysteries of Westgate)
Fixed an issue with the game unpausing after selecting a Quickcast spell when Quickcast Auto-Pause was enabled. (Controller)
Fixed an issue with the game softlocking at the Crossroad Keep Basement if Vale died.
Fixed issues in the controller UI for the hotbar, inventory, Area Map, focus, Spirit Energy, and item descriptions
Fixed an issue with the camera after talking to Vale when in Strategy Mode
Patch 1 is now available on all platforms. As we continue making improvements to the game in the future, please report any issues to our support team at
support.aspyr.com
Resolved an issue where the "Perform Default Action on Target" setting was not working as intended.
Corrected a bug where a Construct would gain Warlock feats when upgraded.
Fixed an issue where most of the main character's voice-over options would play in English even when the game was set to other languages.
Addressed a bug where players were unable to scroll the list of modules using the mouse wheel.
Fixed an issue where certain classes were incorrectly greyed out in the Level Up screen, even when they were available to be chosen.
Addressed an issue in character creation where a voice preview would play the previous entry instead of the selected one.
Resolved an issue where a player's character would be duplicated after canceling character selection, loading into the game, and the host then transitioning to a new area.
Fixed a bug where there was no vibration feedback when a player in stealth was detected by an enemy.
Fixed an issue where the Construct's upgrade did not complete when using Sand's Craft Alchemy dialogue option.
Fixed a bug where the old UI would appear on the screen when connecting to a public legacy server by IP.
Resolved an issue where the spell list was not fully visible and lacked a scroll bar in the Level Up screen.
Fixed a bug where the server description could not be scrolled in the Server Details menu.
Resolved an issue where advanced settings in multiplayer would reset after restarting the game.
Corrected an issue where the item description would flicker after opening.
Fixed a bug where the "Item Creation Feats" text didn't fit on a single line in German.
Addressed an issue in the character level-up screen where some of the names for Available Feats were obscured.
Resolved an issue where long NPC names were being cut off in dialogue.
Corrected a bug where the minus icon was incorrectly displayed as a plus icon when hovering over the "Normal" section in Known Spells within the Spell popup.
Corrected an issue where the slider/scroll would remain in its current state after switching classes/tabs/info or reopening a menu. (Console UI)
Fixed a bug where the Spirit Energy and Area Map menus could be opened simultaneously with the Character, Spells or Journal menus. (Console UI)
Addressed an issue where a player could not move an item to another tab in the hotbar. (Console UI)
Fixed a bug where a message about unsuccessful crafting was not displayed. (Console UI)
Resolved an issue where users were unable to unpin quick chat commands from the Hotbar. (Console UI)
Corrected a bug where character mode could be enabled when the spell targeting circle is active. (Console UI)
Addressed an issue where pressing "Accept" on Advanced Options would close the Options menu. (Console UI)
Fixed a bug where unnecessary buttons appeared in the City Trade menu if there were no goods in the Storm of Zehir DLC. (Console UI)
Resolved an issue where after removing a character from the party, the character could be added twice in the Party Selection screen. (Console UI)
Resolved an issue where players could not exit the "Give Gold" screen after pressing the X button to enter the gold amount. (Controller)
Fixed a bug where the "Next Focus" function would not work when pressing the RB button on the controller. (Controller)
Addressed a bug in the Spellbook popup where the "Expand" button state was not displayed after pressing the "Collapse" button in the Known Spells section. (Controller)
Fixed a bug where the quick bar tab number wouldn't update spells correctly when switching from a controller to a mouse.
Addressed an issue where mouse buttons 4 and 5 could not be properly bound to actions.
Fixed a bug in multiplayer where the "P" key did not correctly open the Player List popup.
Addressed an issue where the "Turn Camera on Mouse Hitting Edge" setting was inverted in Exploration and Character modes.
Corrected a bug where "Strategy Mode" was displayed every time a user opened the Camera settings.
Resolved a bug where the "Turn Camera & Scroll Camera on Mouse Hitting Edge of Screen" settings were not working for Windowed mode.
Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear after loading a game while a Player Password was set.
Addressed a stability issue where performance would drop when moving the DM Creator window.
Fixed a bug where text would overlap in several sections of the Dungeon Master Creator.
Resolved an issue where right-clicking any Waypoint in the DM Chooser would crash the game.
Fixed a bug where opening the Special Abilities menu with a mouse would crash the game while being a DM.
Addressed an issue where loading the game with a client present would cause the game to freeze for the host.
Resolved an issue where the game would crash when deleting content in the "Party Biography" section within the Party Editor popup.
Fixed a bug in the Storm of Zehir overworld where the screen would flicker during leader switching.

Resolved an issue where several campaign-related achievements, including "Not Guilty," "Wall of the Faithless," "Another Mystery Solved," and "The Road Ahead," were not unlocked for clients in multiplayer sessions.
Interim Patch (Pre-Patch 1)

We’ve released an interim patch in our lead-up to Patch 1. A larger first patch will be released for all platforms as soon as possible, but in the meantime please continue to report any bugs to our support team at
support.aspyr.com
Fixed an issue that could occur when joining a Persistent World server where the cursor was missing and controllers would not function on the loading screen.
Fixed a crash that could occur when using custom emotes from modules or Persistent Worlds.
Fixed an issue with Quicksave not being able to be re-bound in the Keymapping Tab (Steam only)
Fixed an issue where the default keybind for Quicksave was also the default shortcut for “Take Screenshot” (Steam only)
Fixed a crash that could occur when using the Staff of the Magi.
Fixed an issue where some UI mods displayed unintended blue artifacts.
Fixed an issue when connecting to Persistent World servers where the Progress Bar displayed misleading information.
Fixed an issue on Persistent World servers where Server Vault character names and information would not display correctly in the Select Character list.
Fixed an issue where Local Vault characters would appear in the Select Character list on servers that had the “Local Character Allowed” option turned off.
Fixed an issue on Persistent World servers where texture maps could flicker when clipping the camera through certain assets in large areas.
